list.title: Practice
list.description: Rehearse out loud against realistic AI prospects. Turn on the co-pilot to train exactly like a real call, or go solo to build independent skill.
list.emptyDescription: Use a ready-made scenario above, describe a prospect in one sentence, or generate a random one so you can't memorise it.

generateDialog.title: Describe a prospect
generateDialog.description: One sentence is enough. CallZen fills in personality, objections, hidden pain points and conditions to convert. You review before saving.

examples.one: A skeptical IT manager at a 200-person bank who just renewed with a competitor
examples.two: A small restaurant owner being cold-called about a POS system, rushed during lunch
examples.three: A couple looking for a 3-bedroom house in the suburbs with a limited budget

agentCard.deleteDescription: The prospect is permanently deleted. Past practice sessions stay in your call library.

randomDialog.title: Random prospect
randomDialog.description: Get a surprise prospect within your limits, so you can't memorise the scenario.

voicePicker.unsupported: Not supported in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge.
voicePicker.noVoices: No voices for this language were found; your browser's default voice will be used.

validation.describeInSentence: Describe the prospect in a sentence

editor.description: Who the prospect is, how they behave, and what they hide. Hidden details are only revealed after the session.

scenario.sectionDescription: Who the prospect is and the situation of the call.
scenario.name: Scenario name
scenario.whoPlaceholder: The operations manager of a 50-person logistics company who is frustrated with their current software.
scenario.situationPlaceholder: A cold call out of the blue during a busy workday.
scenario.copilotHint: Also pre-selects this co-pilot for practice.

hidden.title: Hidden layer
hidden.description: Never shown before or during the session. Revealed in the analysis.
hidden.painPointsDescription: Revealed only through good discovery questions.
hidden.painPointsPlaceholder: Loses two jobs a week to double bookings
hidden.objectionPlaceholder: "We are happy with our current vendor"
hidden.hiddenInfoDescription: Shared only if asked the right question or after trust is built.
hidden.hiddenInfoPlaceholder: Budget was already approved for Q3
hidden.conditionsDescription: What you must do for the prospect to agree.
hidden.conditionsPlaceholder: Must quantify ROI before discussing price

identity.title: Identity & background
identity.description: Details that make the persona consistent and realistic.
identity.languagesHint: The prospect starts in the starred language and switches if you switch to another one they speak.
identity.backgroundPlaceholder: Started the business 15 years ago and distrusts salespeople.
identity.briefingPlaceholder: Daniel Brooks, owner of Brooks Plumbing. Lead from a business directory. Never heard of you.
identity.briefingHint: What a salesperson would realistically know before dialing. Shown before the session.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Pick the provider and a voice that fits the persona.

session.connectionDropped: The voice connection dropped. End the session to save what was captured.
session.transcriptHidden: Hidden for a more realistic call. It's saved either way.

start.briefingHint: Only what you'd realistically know before the call. Hidden details are revealed afterwards.
start.copilotHint: Live suggestions exactly like a real call. The prospect can't hear them.
start.createCopilot: <link>Create a co-pilot</link> to practice with live suggestions.
start.headphones: Use headphones for the most realistic experience.
